cards.card_text: God lists the garments: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban and a sash.
cards.verse_text: These are the garments that they shall make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban, and a sash.
cards.snippet: …shall make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban, and a sash.

cards.card_text: The gold plate is fastened with a blue cord to the front of Aaron's turban.
cards.verse_text: Fasten to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban; it shall be on the front of the turban.
cards.snippet: Fasten to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban; it shall be on the front of the turban.

cards.card_text: Aaron gets a fine linen tunic, a fine linen turban and an embroidered sash, and his sons get tunics, sashes and headbands.
cards.verse_text: You are to weave the tunic with fine linen, make the turban of fine linen, and fashion an embroidered sash.
cards.snippet: You are to weave the tunic with fine linen, make the turban of fine linen, and fashion an embroidered sash.

cards.card_text: Next, Moses is to dress Aaron in the garments, from the tunic to the turban with its holy diadem, and anoint him by pouring oil on his head.
cards.verse_text: Put the turban on his head and attach the holy diadem to the turban.
cards.snippet: Put the turban on his head and attach the holy diadem to the turban.

cards.card_text: Then come the linen pieces: tunics, a turban, ornate headbands, undergarments and a sash embroidered with blue, purple and scarlet yarn.
cards.verse_text: For Aaron and his sons they made tunics of fine linen, the work of a weaver, as well as the turban of fine linen, the ornate headbands and undergarments of finely spun linen, and the sash of finely spun linen, embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
cards.snippet: …of fine linen, the work of a weaver, as well as the turban of fine linen, the ornate headbands and undergarments of finely spun linen,…

cards.verse_text: Then they fastened to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
cards.snippet: …they fastened to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

cards.card_text: Last comes the turban on Aaron's head.
cards.verse_text: Moses also put the turban on Aaron’s head and set the gold plate, the holy diadem, on the front of the turban, as the LORD had commanded him.
cards.snippet: Moses also put the turban on Aaron’s head and set the gold plate, the holy diadem, on…

cards.card_text: Aaron brings a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering, and he wears holy linen garments: a tunic, undergarments, a sash and a turban.
cards.verse_text: He must tie a linen sash around him and put on the linen turban.
cards.snippet: …must tie a linen sash around him and put on the linen turban.

cards.card_text: Job says righteousness ___ him, and justice was his robe and his turban.
cards.verse_text: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me; justice was my robe and my turban.
cards.snippet: …on righteousness, and it clothed me; justice was my robe and my turban.

cards.card_text: The turban and the crown The robe and the ring The sword and the shield
cards.verse_text: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Remove the turban, and take off the crown.
cards.snippet: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Remove the turban, and take off the crown.

cards.card_text: But Oholibah goes further: she sees men engraved on a wall in vermilion, with belts on their waists and flowing turbans on their heads.
cards.verse_text: She saw the men portrayed on the wall, images of the Chaldeans, engraved in vermilion, wearing belts on their waists and flowing turbans on their heads; all of them looked like officers of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their birth.
cards.snippet: …the Chaldeans, engraved in vermilion, wearing belts on their waists and flowing turbans on their heads; all of them looked like officers of the Babylonians…

cards.card_text: His turban and his sandals Sackcloth and a torn robe His cloak and his belt
cards.verse_text: Put on your turban and strap your sandals on your feet; do not cover your lips or eat the bread of mourners.”
cards.snippet: Put on your turban and strap your sandals on your feet; do not cover your lips…

cards.card_text: Ezekiel says that when God desecrates His sanctuary, the people will take off their turbans and sandals.
cards.verse_text: Your turbans will remain on your heads and your sandals on your feet.
cards.snippet: Your turbans will remain on your heads and your sandals on your feet.

cards.card_text: In they go, still wearing their robes, trousers and turbans.
cards.verse_text: So they were tied up, wearing robes, trousers, turbans, and other clothes, and they were thrown into the blazing fiery furnace.
cards.snippet: So they were tied up, wearing robes, trousers, turbans, and other clothes, and they were thrown into the blazing fiery furnace.

cards.card_text: Zechariah asks them to put a ___ turban on Joshua's head.
cards.verse_text: Then I said, “Let them put a clean turban on his head.” So a clean turban was placed on his head, and they clothed him, as the angel of the LORD stood by.
cards.snippet: Then I said, “Let them put a clean turban on his head.” So a clean turban was placed on his head,…

cards.card_text: So a clean turban goes on Joshua's head, and they clothe him while the angel of the LORD stands by.
cards.verse_text: Then I said, “Let them put a clean turban on his head.” So a clean turban was placed on his head, and they clothed him, as the angel of the LORD stood by.
cards.snippet: Then I said, “Let them put a clean turban on his head.” So a clean turban was placed on his head,…
